title: Devflow Diff Result
description: Schema for implementation diff artifacts produced by the Devflow Software Factory workflow.

task_id.description: The task identifier, e.g. T-001 or 001

files_touched.description: List of file paths modified by the diff

files_outside_allowed.description: Files in the diff that are outside the task's allowed paths

protected_files_touched.description: Protected files in the diff that require approval

apply_status.description: Whether the diff has been applied
